'''Rethys''' was a type of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] terrain. The [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]] on [[Thrantin]] trained its students in a number of aquatic environments, including rethys.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
